kwaipilot/kat-coder-v2.5-dev is an openweight, MixtureofExperts (MoE) coding foundation model released by Kwaipilot (Kuaishou's AI team) optimized specifically for agentic software engineering and tooluse workflows.[1][2][3]



 Key Overview and Architecture

 Base Architecture: MixtureofExperts built on top of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.[2]
 Parameter Count: 35 billion total parameters with 3B actively routed per token.[1][2]
 Modality: Textonly; the open weights exclude multimodal and visual encoders.[2][1]
 Context Length: Up to 262,144 tokens (256K context window).[4][2]
 License: Apache 2.0 (openweight, permissive for commercial applications).[2]



 Strengths and Training Highlights

 Agentic Repository Coding: Posttrained with largescale supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) in executable repository environments to handle issue localization, multifile code modifications, and autonomous bug fixing.[3][4][2]
 High Benchmark Performance: Achieves stateoftheart results for its parameter class on benchmarks like SWEbench Verified (~69.40%).[3]
 Mitigated Pathological Behaviors: RL training reduced singleturn repetition and drastically reduced tool label syntax errors (from 9.34% to 0.28%).[5]
 Flexible Reasoning: Supports dual modes, providing extended chainofthought reasoning traces as well as direct output modes.[3]



 Deployment and Ecosystem Support

 Inference Engines: Supported outofthebox by Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and KTransformers.[1][2]
 Local Quantization: Quantized GGUF formats (via bartowski) allow local execution using llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, and Jan AI.[6][7]
 Agent Frameworks: Compatible with developer agent toolchains such as Claude Code, OpenHands, and Kilo Code.[8][9][4]
